response.sql: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), department_shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM department_shares) SELECT department_shares.department, department_shares.member_count, department_shares.share, department_shares.share - average_share.share AS share_above_average FROM department_shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE department_shares.share > average_share.share
